verdict.rationale: Notion claims agents that 'keep work moving 24/7', and its Agent APIs let you manage Custom Agents' status, usage and credit limits, which points to autonomously running agents. Most other automation evidence relies on developer plumbing: webhooks plus internal connections 'ideal for custom automations', which need your own endpoint or scripts. Missing for 10: documentation of how to configure background agent triggers and schedules, native no-code automation rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually run unattended.
